examples.text: tatra, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho eta'r'ahi rūpena khajjāmi. atītam'p'āhaṃ addhānaṃ evam'eva rūpena khajjiṃ, seyyathā'pi eta'r'ahi paccuppannena rūpena khajjāmi

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, udāyi, yo vā maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭh'aṃso suparikammakato paṇḍukambale nikkhitto bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca, yo vā ratt'andhakāratimisāya kimi khajjopanako, imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ katamo vaṇṇo abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā'ti?

ayaṃ pan'ettha saṅkhepo, bhagavato kira bhikkhusaṅghassa ca pañcannaṃ mahānadīnaṃ mah'oghasadise lābhasakkāre uppanne hatalābhasakkārā aññatitthiyā sūriy'uggamanakāle khajjopanakā viya nippabhā hutvā ekato sannipatitvā mantayiṃsu.
ubho khañjā ubho kuṇī, ubho visamacakkhukā, ubhinnaṃ piḷakā jātā, n'āhaṃ passāmi illisan'ti.

23392.commentary: (SNa) khattiyamahāsālā'ti khattiyamahāsālā nāma mahāsārappattā khattiyā. yesaṃ hi khattiyānaṃ heṭṭhim'antena koṭisataṃ nidhānagataṃ hoti, tayo kahāpaṇakumbhā valañjan'atthāya gehamajjhe rāsiṃ katvā ṭhapitā honti, te khattiyamahāsālā nāma.

examples.text: ye'pi te, mahārāja, khattiyamahāsālā aḍḍhā mahaddhanā mahābhogā pahūtajātarūparajatā pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇā pahūtadhanadhaññā, tesam'pi jātānaṃ n'atthi aññatra jarāmaraṇā.

idh'āhaṃ, bhante, aḍḍakaraṇe nisinno passāmi khattiyamahāsāle'pi brāhmaṇamahāsāle'pi gahapatimahāsāle'pi aḍḍhe mahaddhane mahābhoge pahūtajātarūparajate pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇe pahūtadhanadhaññe kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsante.

23393.meaning1: wealthy family of the warrior caste

examples.text: idh'ānanda, ekacco ucce kule paccājāto hoti, khattiyamahāsālakule vā brāhmaṇamahāsālakule vā gahapatimahāsālakule vā, aḍḍhe mahaddhane mahābhoge pahūtajātarūparajate pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇe pahūtadhanadhaññe.

23395.meaning1: one thousand men of the warrior caste; one thousand nobles

examples.text: rañño, ānanda, mahāsudassanassa… caturāsīti itthisahassāni ahesuṃ subhaddādevippamukhāni, caturāsīti gahapatisahassāni ahesuṃ gahapatiratana-ppamukhāni, caturāsīti khattiyasahassāni ahesuṃ anuyantāni pariṇāyakaratanappamukhāni

23396.meaning2: tender and delicate like a royal prince
